approved_payload.content: Police say a 39-year-old police sergeant stationed at Witpoort police station allegedly shot his 35-year-old wife dead on Wednesday 21 October in Martinique village, in the Villa Nora policing area; she was declared dead at the scene. He fled in his white Isuzu bakkie. At about 06:30 on Thursday 22 October police found the bakkie parked along the road in Botshabelo Section, Tom Burke policing area, about 100 metres from his body under a marula tree, with a gunshot wound to the head and his state-issued firearm next to him. An inquest docket was opened at Tom Burke. Motive unknown; domestic violence not ruled out (police spokesperson Col Malesela Ledwaba, via TimesLIVE). TimesLIVE's opening line says Abbotspoort village; its own report and police place the shooting in Martinique village. No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police: TimesLIVE and Limpopo Chronicle. The suspect is a police officer. The pin is approximate (village level).
